text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-f-t-e-d f-i-x-e-d b-i-d-d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s a-n-d f-i-l-e-d t-h-e-m a-s c-o-v-e-r b-i-d-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g p-a-p-e-r w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-g-r-e-e-d o-n s-e-c-r-e-t p-a-y-m-e-n-t t-e-r-m-s a-n-d l-e-f-t a n-o-t-e o-f c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e o-f f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l i-n-t-e-r-e-s-t-s.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d b-a-s-e p-r-i-c-e d-a-t-a a-m-o-n-g b-i-d-d-e-r-s a-n-d l-e-f-t a s-h-a-r-e-d s-p-r-e-a-d-s-h-e-e-t, b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e n-e-e-d f-o-r i-s-o-l-a-t-e-d c-a-l-c-u-l-a-t-i-o-n-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d a r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n t-a-b-l-e f-o-r w-i-n-n-i-n-g r-o-u-n-d-s a-n-d f-i-l-e-d t-h-e s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e, i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g a-u-d-i-t c-h-e-c-k-s o-n a-l-l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-o-r-m-a-t-t-e-d r-e-s-u-l-t-s t-o a-p-p-e-a-r c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e a-n-d l-e-f-t a p-u-b-l-i-c s-u-m-m-a-r-y, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-v-i-e-w o-f m-u-l-t-i-p-l-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t q-u-o-t-e-s.
